11.speaker: MC
11.text: Hi everyone, thank you so much for coming tonight.
11.id: Teman-teman semua, aku mau bilang terima kasih banyak udah hadir pada malam hari ini.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Thanks for making the time to be here.
11.id: Terima kasih sudah menyempatkan waktu untuk hadir di malam hari ini.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Tonight, just relax and have fun,
11.id: Pokoknya aku pengen teman-teman semua malam hari ini santai aja,

11.speaker: MC
11.text: because we're all here to have a good time
11.id: karena kita mau seru-seruan bareng

11.speaker: MC
11.text: and celebrate someone really special to us.
11.id: dan mau merayakan ulang tahun orang yang spesial buat kita.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Okay, I feel like you guys are a bit quiet...
11.id: Oke, karena kayaknya aku merasa kurang semangat...

11.speaker: MC
11.text: so let me check the crowd first.
11.id: aku mau tes ombak dulu nih.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Let me hear you!
11.id: Aku mau denger dulu nih!

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Where's my left side at?!
11.id: Mana suaranya yang di sebelah kiri aku?!

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Tonight's going to be so much fun,
11.id: Karena acara malam hari ini akan seru banget,

11.speaker: MC
11.text: and we've still got a long night ahead —
11.id: karena acara malam hari ini masih panjang —

11.speaker: MC
11.text: there are lots of games coming up, with prizes too!
11.id: masih akan ada banyak game seru yang tentunya berhadiah juga!

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Okay, I don't want to be up here alone for too long.
11.id: Oke, tanpa berlama-lama, aku gak mau sendiri lama-lama di sini.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Let me call up someone who's been waiting on the left...
11.id: Aku mau panggil seseorang yang sepertinya udah nunggu di sebelah kiri kita...

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Give it up for... the birthday girl!
11.id: Aku mau panggil... The Birthday Girl!

11.speaker: MC
11.text: I hope everything Jesslyn's dreaming of comes true this year.
11.id: Semoga apapun yang diimpikan, apapun yang dicita-citakan Jesslyn bisa tercapai di usia yang baru ini.

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Okay everyone — doesn't Jesslyn look so pretty tonight?
11.id: Oke, teman-teman, aku mau tanya dulu nih — Jesslyn cantik gak malam hari ini?

11.speaker: MC
11.text: Jesslyn, say something to all your friends who came tonight —
11.id: Sampaikan ke teman-teman yang udah hadir pada malam hari ini,

11.speaker: MC
11.text: or to your family.
11.id: atau buat keluarga juga boleh.

11.speaker: Jesslyn
11.text: Thank you so much, everyone.
11.id: Terima kasih banyak.

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Before I pick someone — anyone want to go first?
12.id: Sebelum aku tunjuk, ada yang mau duluan gak?

12.speaker: MC
12.text: No one? Okay, I'll just pick!
12.id: Gak ada yang mau? Gimana nih? Aku tunjuk aja ya!

12.speaker: Jesslyn
12.text: I have a request!
12.id: Aku mau request!

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Oh, you've got a request? Sure — who?
12.id: Oh, kamu mau request! Boleh, siapa?

12.text: Stevi, come up!
12.id: Stevi, maju!

12.speaker: Jesslyn
12.text: Stevi, Fiona, Shalom.
12.id: Stevi, Fiona, Shalom.

12.speaker: Stevi
12.text: I just want Jesslyn to stay healthy, and to always be as nice as she is.
12.id: Pokoknya aku pengen Jesslyn sehat selalu, semoga Jesslyn selalu baik.

12.speaker: Stevi
12.text: And I hope she never loses that smile.
12.id: Dan aku harap Jesslyn gak pernah kehilangan senyumnya.

12.speaker: Stevi
12.text: Just keep getting better and better!
12.id: Makin, makin darling, makin semuanya — makin baik lah pokoknya!

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Thank you, Stevi.
12.id: Thank you, Stevi.

12.speaker: Jesslyn
12.text: Thank you so much!
12.id: Thank you so much!

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Who's next, Jesslyn?
12.id: Yang kedua tadi siapa ya, Jesslyn?

12.speaker: Jesslyn
12.text: Fiona.
12.id: Fiona.

12.speaker: Fiona
12.text: Thank you so much for inviting me, Jesslyn, and I wish you all the best.
12.id: Makasih banget Jesslyn udah undang aku, and I wish you all the best.

12.speaker: Fiona
12.text: I hope you stay the kindest person that I've ever met.
12.id: And I hope you stay the kindest person that I've ever met.

12.speaker: Fiona
12.text: Thank you, Jesslyn.
12.id: Thank you, Jesslyn.

12.speaker: Shalom
12.text: Thank you for being my friend.
12.id: Aku mau ucapin terima kasih, karena udah kenal aku.

12.speaker: Shalom
12.text: Happy birthday — stay healthy, stay happy, and I hope all your dreams come true.
12.id: Semoga Jesslyn panjang umur, sehat selalu, bahagia selalu, dan cita-citanya tercapai.

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Okay, thank you!
12.id: Oke, thank you!

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Jesslyn, can I pick one more person?
12.id: Jesslyn, aku boleh gak tunjuk satu orang lagi, terakhir?

12.speaker: MC
12.text: How do you know Jesslyn?
12.id: Kamu kenal Jesslyn dari mana?

12.speaker: MC
12.text: From school?
12.id: Temen sekolah?

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Since when? — Since last year.
12.id: Dari tahun berapa? — Dari tahun lalu.

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Only since last year, but you two are already so close!
12.id: Oh, berarti baru tahun lalu, tapi udah merasa dekat ya sama Jesslyn.

12.speaker: Friend
12.text: I hope only good things come your way this year — and stay the good person you are.
12.id: Semoga di tahun ini semua hal yang positif datang ke kamu, dan tetap jadi orang baik.

12.speaker: Friend
12.text: Thank you, Jesslyn.
12.id: Terima kasih, Jesslyn.

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Thank you to all four of Jesslyn's friends for those sweet wishes.
12.id: Terima kasih banyak buat keempat teman Jesslyn tadi yang udah memanjatkan ucapan serta doa-doanya.

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Next up, the main event — blowing out the candles and cutting the cake!
12.id: Oke, selanjutnya kita masuk ke inti acara malam hari ini: tiup lilin dan potong kue!

12.speaker: MC
12.text: Can Jesslyn and her family come up to the front?
12.id: Sebelumnya saya undang Jesslyn beserta keluarga untuk menempati posisi di depan.

13.speaker: MC
13.text: Are you from school, or…? How do you know Jesslyn?
13.id: Kamu temen sekolah, temen rumah, atau temen apanya Jesslyn?

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: Is it okay if I speak in English?
13.id: Aku izin pakai bahasa Inggris, ya.

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: Thank you for inviting me over, Jesslyn,

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: and I wish you all the best.

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: I've heard about your plans for the future,

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: so in my prayers, I will always be praying for you

13.speaker: Friend
13.text: Thank you for inviting me, Jesslyn. Thank you.

14.text: ♪ Happy birthday, happy birthday, happy birthday, Jesslyn ♪

14.id: ♪ Tiup lilinnya, tiup lilinnya, tiup lilinnya sekarang ♪
14.text: ♪ Blow the candles, blow the candles, blow the candles now ♪

14.speaker: MC
14.text: Stay right there for a sec.

18.speaker: MC
18.id: Ada apa pilihannya? Biru, pink, dan...
18.text: The options are… blue, pink, and…

18.speaker: MC
18.id: Berarti kalian tadi jawabnya benar semua, gak?
18.text: So did you all get it right?

27.speaker: MC
27.id: Hadiahnya... aku panggil lagi ke depan.
27.text: For the prize, I'll call you back up.
